analysis.summary: Indo Tech Transformers reported its full-year FY2026 results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, showing revenue of ₹782 Cr and PAT of ₹93 Cr. Management highlighted high capacity utilization of 80-90% and an executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr. The company outlined a phased capacity expansion plan to reach 50,000 MVA by FY29 with a total capex of ₹495 Cr. Additionally, management noted strong financial metrics including near-zero net debt, cash reserves exceeding ₹114 Cr, and an improved debtor days of 56. Indo Tech Transformers Limited presented its full-year FY2026 results and Q1 FY2026-27 update, reporting significant growth in revenue and PAT alongside a strong executable order book of ₹1,318 Cr.
